production.direction_en: At the archive door, Yseldra waits beneath the bell tower. Seven wax seals hang from her chain, each cut through the center.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_bell_widow — first full statement; Yseldra's seven seals click as percussion | battle: bgm_boss_bell_widow | post: bgm_tension, cut to silence on 'She escaped.'

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: She could have killed us. She chose the bell tower instead.

commands.speaker: yseldra_distant
commands.text: Ask who keeps the hour running.

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: Oakhaven is marked on the map. I will warn them before the soldiers arrive.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: She knows I am dying. That does not mean I can let Mahmut know.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: He lied to me, gently. So we are both keeping something.
